protocol.inferential_statistics: Not reported: the released arrays do not identify independent events or spatial blocks.
protocol.boundary_metric: Per-tile boundary F1 with one-pixel Chebyshev (3x3, 8-neighbour) symmetric matching tolerance.
protocol.matched_recall: Each model threshold is selected at the exact validation-score breakpoint nearest U-Net validation recall at threshold 0.5; ties prefer the higher threshold, which is then applied to test.
protocol.controlled_resolution: PlanetScope test arrays downsampled 128->38 and bilinearly restored to 128, holding sensor, region, labels and model fixed.

runs.matched_validation_recall_tie_policy: minimum recall mismatch, then highest threshold
